name: worktree-write-boundary
body: The write boundary between a change-set's project worktree and the main checkout: the rule set that makes every code-writer write land in `<main>/apg/.worktrees/<project>/` and never in main. It has two faces that must agree — the permission grants the agent-builder scaffolds for each generated code-writer (edit globs + fs-tool path scope, worktree-rooted), and the fs tools' own scope decision (grants and candidate in one frame; a main-resolving path refused). Main-writing roles are only the carve-outs of `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`.
